name.description: The name of the function argument.

dataType.description:
The data type of the argument. Examples are:
`int`, `string`, `double`, `map<string, double>`.

dataTypeDisplay.description:
The data type of the argument as it should be displayed in the UI.
If not provided, the displayed data type is inferred from
the `dataType` field. If the data type cannot be resolved, the
default value is `Any`.

value.description:
The value passed to this argumenet for instantiation
of the native class instance.

description.description:
A description to help explain what this argument is
and what it does.

isKey.description:
Is this an important hyperparameter that greatly influences
the behavior of the python class?

isForInferenceOnly.description:
Can this parameter be changed without having to retrain
the model? An example is "alert threshold". If there is a model
that raises an alert based on a value exceeding a threshold,
once set to a new value, the new model may run
inference without requiring retraining.

options.description:
If specified, this argument will display these options in a dropdown menu in the UI,
preventing the user from entering custom values.

title:
Every python class backing a {@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipe} will have
an `__init__` function with named arguments. This Type contains the metadata
for one keyword argument to the `__init__` function.
name: ReliabilityMl.CustomPipeKwarg
